timelens.homeView.name: Home
timelens.enabled.description: Enable local VS Code usage tracking for TimeLens.
timelens.apiBaseUrlCacheSeconds.descript: How long to cache the discovered local API port (seconds). Set to 0 to re-discover on every request.
timelens.bridgeKey.description: Extension bridge key for authenticating with TimeLens local API. Get this from Settings > Local API / Extension Bridge.
timelens.apiToken.description: Local API token for authenticating with TimeLens when token-required mode is enabled. Get this from Settings > Local API / Tokens.
timelens.flushIntervalSeconds.descriptio: How often to flush queued sessions to TimeLens API.
timelens.idleThresholdSeconds.descriptio: Split a session when editor activity is idle for this many seconds.
timelens.trackingLevel.description: How much data to record per VS Code session.
timelens.trackingLevel.basic: Only record session duration (no language or project info).
timelens.trackingLevel.standard: Record session duration and language distribution (recommended).
timelens.trackingLevel.detailed: Record session duration, language distribution, and project path.
